meta.purpose: Lab-presentation showpiece maps (descriptive products; no verdict words, no accuracy claims beyond the registered map records)
style_refs: scripts/4_visualization/paper_v3/maps_alt_v3.py (ALT and difference colormaps, native-cell mesh, basemap)
meta.compute: CPU only (CatBoost CPU through h54 WFFitter, 4 threads, nice 10); no GPU is needed for any product

label_sequence.message: How the 1 km ALT map of a region changes as the number of label cells used by the workflow grows from 0 to all
label_sequence.draw: nested block-dispersed order with seed 0: blocks permuted (RandomState(0)), cells within each block permuted, round-robin over blocks; the first n cells of this one order are the n label cells, so each step keeps the previous cells

method_by_n.0: source-coefficient Stefan P0 = E0 * sqrt(TDD); E0 = least squares on the source pool (all other regions, 100 km buffer; h54.build_rctx rule via map_alaska_v1.region_context)
method_by_n.10: recalibrated Stefan P1 = E_n * sqrt(TDD); E_n = (n E_ls + kappa E0)/(n + kappa), kappa = 10 (h54 RUnit.coefs)
method_by_n.40,160,all: recalibrated anchor + residual CatBoost R1 = E_n * sqrt(TDD) + lambda * mean_g(seeds 0, 1); lambda in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} by within-label 0.5 deg block 5-fold CV (h54 RUnit.lam_cv through map_alaska_v1.fit_r1); if fewer than 2 blocks the rule returns 0.25 and the flag is recorded

label_sequence.outputs_data: data/processed/map_<region>/label_sequence_v1/pred_n<N>.csv.gz (cell_id, pred, p1, corr) + label_sequence_v1_meta.json (seed, cells, E0, E_ls, E_n, lambda, K, flag, fit time, sha256)

figure_paper.layout: row 1: five ALT maps on one shared scale (same range as the registered v3 map of the region); row 2: change versus the all-label map, zero-centred diverging scale shared across the row; label cells as black points on every map; label count under each column; panel letters a-e / f-j
figure_paper.numbers_in_figure: label counts only (category labels); no RMSE

figure_slide.layout: same 2 x 5 matrix, vertical colour bars at the right

gif.frames: one per n: ALT map (left) and change versus all-label map (right), fixed colour limits, label cells drawn

hillshade.message: The residual-ML 1 km ALT map draped on terrain relief; relief is display context only
hillshade.dem: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 tiles listed in <region>_grid_dem_tiles_v1.csv, reprojected and averaged to 250 m in the map projection (rasterio reproject, Resampling.average)
hillshade.drape: multiply blend: rgb * ((1 - w) + w * shade), w = 0.35; ALT colour from the nearest 1 km cell within 1 km (water and no-data cells keep the basemap colours)
hillshade.annotations: slim colour bar, scale bar, one grey note line: '1 km ALT on 250 m hillshade; information resolution ~10 km (climate input)'

cover_bg.content: Alaska hillshade-draped ALT map (no basemap text) filling the right ~60 % of the canvas; horizontal alpha gradient to white across the left 40 % (alpha 0 for x <= 0.30 W, smoothstep to 1 at x = 0.52 W); no text; background behind the title zone (x <= 0.30 W) >= 95 % white
cover_bg.check: measure mean luminance of the left 30 % band in the exported PNG

lena_3d.renderer: matplotlib plot_surface (DEM at 500 m, vertical exaggeration stated in the note) or pyvista off-screen if the EGL/OSMesa context works

checks: GIF <= 8 MB and frame delay 120 cs

notes: no GPU used; CatBoost CPU 4 threads; max RSS 1.75 GB (Alaska)
Lena n = 40 and 160 choose lambda = 1.0 and the residual model pushes the north-east delta beyond the 70 cm scale end (shown with the arrow)
the all-label Lena map here is the in-region R1 (labels only, lambda 0.5), not the registered Lena final map (source-pooled h49 R1, lambda 0.25)
